atoms.b: Fossils are a ((++useful useless)) tool to learn about how Earth has changed.
Most of the species that have been found in fossils are now ((++extinct still_alive)).
Scientists that study fossils are called ((++palaeontologists dermatologists)).

instruction.text: Read the following text about a fossil site in the UK and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The largest fossil in the UK was found in Rutland. The fossil belongs to an ichthyosaur, a predator that lived in the water. It is believed that the ichthyosaurs went extinct around 90 million years ago. The fossil of this particular ichthyosaur is thought to be about 180 million years old.

atoms.a: The fossil is of what predator?
How old is the fossil thought to be?

instruction.text: Read the following text about a fossil site in the UK and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The ichthyosaur fossil is the largest fossil that has been found in the UK. The skull alone was 6m long. The total length of the fossil was 10m. When they were alive, the ichthyosaur varied in size between 1 and 25m.

atoms.a: How long was the skull of the ichthyosaur fossil found in Rutland?
What was the total length of the fossil?
What was the size range of ichthyosaurs when they were alive?
